title: Encroaching Mycosynth lets Mairsil cage planeswalkers for their loyalty abilities
summary: Encroaching Mycosynth turns planeswalker cards into artifacts, which is a card type Mairsil's cage trigger can exile, so he gains loyalty abilities without ever being a planeswalker. A caged Chandra, Flameshaper is the engine: her plus ability makes a hasty token copy of Mairsil, and because the per-turn loyalty restriction applies per permanent, each new token can activate again. The primer catalogues a dozen loyalty-ability kill routes and works through the rules edges, including why making Mairsil an actual planeswalker kills him to state-based actions.

notes: Four years of maintained revision notes, with per-card reasoning recording why cards were cut after play.
The rules section resolves five specific interactions rather than asserting the line works.

alternatives.name: Mycosynth Lattice
alternatives.reason: It makes opponents' cards artifacts too, handing the same caging options to anyone who steals or copies Mairsil; Encroaching Mycosynth is ownership-scoped and reaches hand and graveyard, which is where the cage trigger looks.

alternatives.name: Clone effects that give Mairsil the planeswalker type
alternatives.reason: State-based actions bin any permanent with the planeswalker type and no loyalty counters, so making Mairsil a real planeswalker kills him instead of enabling him.
